results.reason_rejected: Development return was below both the baseline and the registered improvement threshold.

finding: Gradual time decay changes the return distribution but does not provide a stable improvement. The three-year decay concentrates gains in 2021 and turns 2023 slightly negative; the five-year decay sacrifices too much cumulative return.
runtime_note: Each score training and replay ran in a separate process with one numerical thread. Retained score inputs and results end at 20231231.
next_step: Keep simple_v2 frozen. Do not test more nearby half-life values; additional tuning would be parameter search around a failed family.
